sentence.incomeCombined: This is the combined income on this statement.
sentence.incomeCombinedNamed: Inflows gather here — mainly {labels}. That is the till the month starts from.
sentence.salaryNamed: Pay-shaped money from {label}. Treat this as the backbone, not spare cash.
sentence.businessNamed: Business-shaped money from {label}. Peaks and dips are normal; the floor stays cautious.
sentence.transferNamed: Transfers in from {label}. Useful, but less steady than a wage or till.
sentence.rentNamed: {label} is spoken for before anything else — home comes off the top.
sentence.schoolFeesNamed: {label} is school money. It is promised, not surplus.
sentence.utilitiesNamed: {label} keeps the lights and water on. Fixed, not optional.
sentence.loanNamed: {label} is a repayment. It leaves before the safe floor is drawn.
sentence.insuranceNamed: {label} is cover you already chose. Count it as taken.
sentence.chamaNamed: {label} is your circle contribution — social saving, not spare cash.
sentence.commitmentNamed: {label} shows up as a regular pull on the statement.
sentence.groceriesNamed: Food and household shopping. It moves with the month.
sentence.transportNamed: Getting around — matatu, fuel, or rides. Small lines that add up.
sentence.airtimeNamed: Airtime and data. Tiny on one day, loud across the month.
sentence.eatingOutNamed: Meals bought outside. A comfort line, not a bill.
sentence.spendingOtherNamed: {category} shows up in the day-to-day pot — about {share}% of typical income.
sentence.spendingTop: {category} is the loudest everyday line — about {share}% of typical income. Worth knowing, not judging.
sentence.surplus: This is what is left after the regular bills.
sentence.surplusNamed: After the named bills and everyday lines, this cautious floor is what is left to consider.
sentence.surplusBusiness: With till-like income, keep habits under this floor — the busy days do not rewrite the quiet ones.
sentence.surplusEmpty: After the bills and everyday lines, the cautious floor is empty. Buffer first; Bitcoin waits.
